2952790216: Identified a set of completion queue processors.%n%nNode number: %1%nGroup number: %2%nProcessor mask: %3%nFirst processor number: %4%nLast processor number: %5%n%nGuidance:%n%nThis event is informational. No action is required.
2952790217: A NUMA node has too few completion queue processors for optimal performance.%n%nNode number: %1%nBase affinity node: %2%nMax affinity node: %3%nBase affinity processor: %4%nMax affinity processor: %5%nProcessor affinity mask: %7%n%nGuidance:%n%nThe configuration parameters BaseAffinityNode, MaxAffinityNode, BaseAffinityProcessor, MaxAffinityProcessor, and ProcessorAffinityMask specify the set of processors that SMB Direct may use for its completion queues. The current configuration values allow only one processor in the specified NUMA node to be used (non-NUMA systems are treated as NUMA systems with one node). This configuration will degrade the performance of any SMB Direct connection that is affinitized to this NUMA node. To correct this issue, increase the number of completion queue processors in this NUMA node to a multiple of two. SMB Direct must be restarted to read updated configuration parameter values from the registry.
2952790218: Failed to identify any completion queue processors.%n%nBase affinity node: %1%nMax affinity node: %2%nBase affinity processor: %3%nMax affinity processor: %4%nProcessor affinity mask: %6%n%nGuidance:%n%nThe configuration parameters BaseAffinityNode, MaxAffinityNode, BaseAffinityProcessor, MaxAffinityProcessor, and ProcessorAffinityMask specify the set of processors that SMB Direct may use for its completion queues. SMB Direct must be restarted to read updated configuration parameter values from the registry.
